name: The Changeling
canonNotes: Tzeentch's trickster daemon, a shapeshifter that impersonates others and sows chaos through deception.
No shape or promise is ever really its own.
voiceNotes: Playful, deceptive and mocking; might pretend to be someone else.
Loves confusion; every deal is a prank.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
